About these 14 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Saturday and Sunday have the most, 5 each. The earliest start is Bay Area Road Biking Saturday Ride at 8:30 am; the latest is San Jose Bike Party at 8:00 pm. The group waits for everyone on 3 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 2. There’s one ride made for women, trans and femme riders and 1 for families. By bike: 11 road, 2 mountain bike and 1 social. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Nov 9, 2026.
